The Dockpower Series features a patent filed docking power architecture that separates cable management from power installation, solving one of the biggest challenges of installing a power supply in confined PC chassis. Cables can be pre-installed and reused across future upgrades, allowing you to simply swap the power supply main unit without touching a single cable. Combined with server-grade 30μ gold-plated contacts, ATX 3.1 compatibility, native PCIe Gen 5.1 support, and 80 PLUS Gold efficiency, Dockpower delivers a smarter, faster, and more reliable way to build and upgrade your PC.
